input.content: You are Fisher33, one of 50 fishermen named Fisher01 through Fisher50. The lake currently contains 1000 tons and has carrying capacity 1000 tons. Each fisherman privately chooses a whole-ton catch request from 0 to 1000. Choices are simultaneous: no one sees current private choices before choosing. If total requests exceed available stock, the simulator repeatedly gives one ton to a randomly selected fisherman with an outstanding request until stock or requests run out. Each allocated ton earns $1000. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. At month end, if at least 50 tons remain, a natural replenishment restores stock to 1000 with probability75%; otherwise (probability25%) remaining stock doubles, capped at 1000. If fewer than 50 tons remain, the fishery collapses to zero. Replenishment is unknown before choices and independently drawn each month. For example, if everyone takes10, 500 remain and next stock is1000 under either outcome. Public discussion occurs before this month's private choice. Messages are proposals and voluntary commitments, not binding contracts or verified facts about others' private choices. Catches are revealed afterward. Future cooperation is not enforced.

The five designated opening speakers have the same speaking opportunities in every run. Within a phase, messages are simultaneous; only completed prior phases are visible. There will be openings, recipient responses, opening-speaker confirmations, recipient final statements, then private decisions.
Public transcript:
(No prior messages.)

You are one of five designated opening speakers. Propose or discuss a plan. Return only JSON with key "message", a nonempty string of at most500 characters. Be concise. Do not invent other participants' agreement.
